name: dondocs
description: Render supported naval correspondence to PDF or Word, and technical publications to PDF, using local resources.
long_description: DonDocs provides configured correspondence, I-Type, SL-3, SL-4 and TM/IETM front-matter layouts. The assistant supplies reviewed content and the companion writes final files to the selected output folder. Machine defaults and temporary render files use separate locations. PDF rendering uses bundled resources; Word needs pandoc on PATH. Cards and file presentation depend on the host. The optional browser handoff opens the configured web editor.

output_dir.title: Output folder
output_dir.description: Where final rendered files are written. Machine defaults use their configured file, and rendering also uses system temporary directories. Pick a folder your file tools may read so the assistant can show the document.

config_path.title: Machine defaults file
config_path.description: Optional companion.config.json with your unit, signer, SSIC and originator code, so they need not be given on every letter. Leave blank to use ~/.dondocs/companion.config.json if it exists.

app_url.title: Web editor address
app_url.description: Where the DonDocs web app is served. A finished letter carries an Edit in browser link there, so a field can be fixed by hand. Clear it to switch the link off.

tools.name: dondocs_letter
tools.description: Render supported correspondence to PDF/Word, or technical publications to PDF

tools.name: dondocs_unit_lookup
tools.description: Find a unit's letterhead and mailing address in the bundled directory

tools.name: dondocs_template_get
tools.description: Fetch a template as a starting draft

tools.name: dondocs_save_defaults
tools.description: Save the unit and signer this machine uses, so later letters need no lookup
